t: L-PRO Extra Life yellow rubber gloves are robust protective gloves designed for general handling tasks. These durable multi-layered natural rubber gloves offer enhanced protection and extended lifespan, making them suitable for various trade and DIY applications, including cleaning, painting and light chemical work. An anti-slip grip pattern on the fingers and palm ensures secure handling in both wet and dry conditions. The rolled beaded cuff provides extra durability and helps prevent liquids from running down the arm. A comfortable cotton flock lining aids sweat absorption and makes the gloves easy to put on and take off.
